intended_use.summary: Evaluate the exact UNOSAT preliminary mapped mudflow/rockflow and analyzed-area vectors only as an independent exclusion and reference-candidate aid for a separately reviewed local ASF VV registration route. No impact attribution, public redistribution, or assertion that unmapped land is unchanged.

sources.name: Satellite-detected mudflow and rockflow extent in Rasuwa and Nuwakot, with separate analyzed-area vector

evidence.note: Publisher page names DOI 10.63253/1y26ihdq, revision 28 August 2026, UNOSAT products 4257 and 4258, and distinct mapped and analyzed-area SHP resources. Exact downloadable bytes have not been bound.

criteria.note: Dataset and resource-page identities are known; source file hashes are not yet known.

evidence.note: UNOSAT is identified as dataset publisher through UNESCO IHP-WINS and as the producer of the underlying products.

criteria.note: Authoritative for its own preliminary mapped event extent, not proof of complete or field-validated impact.

evidence.note: Landing page exposes separate Download controls, but account, rate, exact payload URL, and file-size conditions were not verified; no download was requested.

criteria.note: A visible download control alone does not establish accessible, exact source bytes.

evidence.note: The official mapped-extent resource page displays License and Access rights headings without values.
The official analyzed-area resource page also displays empty License and Access rights fields.

UNITAR general website conditions discuss limited research/private-study extracts with acknowledgement and prior permission for substantial reproduction; they do not specify a license for these exact vectors.

criteria.note: The general website conditions are not an exact vector grant. Attribution, local modification, derivative use, retention, and redistribution constraints remain unestablished for the two exact resource files.

evidence.note: The publisher attributes the preliminary mapping to Sentinel-2 acquired 27 August and PlanetScope acquired 26 August 2026; the resource roles and DOI are retained.

criteria.note: This establishes published lineage metadata, not chain of custody for unacquired vector bytes.

evidence.note: Any later separately authorized intake must use append-only non-Git custody, SHA-256 hashing, archive/member checks, CRS/geometry validation, and exact resource binding before use.

criteria.note: A post-acquisition verification plan is feasible; no actual checksum or integrity result exists.

evidence.note: Metadata report approximately 37 square kilometers of mapped impact and 363 square kilometers analyzed; the exact vector geometry and overlap with usable ASF pair pixels are unverified.

criteria.note: Preliminary, unvalidated mapping may omit affected areas; unmapped land inside or outside the analyzed polygon is not automatically stable.

evidence.note: The proposed input is an aggregate event-extent vector, not person-level data; project rules require licensed data and output outside Git and controlled archive validation.

criteria.note: No account credential is requested or stored; later vector content still requires safe container inspection.

blocking_reasons: Exact vector license and access rights are not stated on the official resource pages
Exact payload access and byte identity are unverified
Preliminary analyzed-area and mapped-extent vectors have not been checked for usable stable-control fitness
No authority to adopt or download this distinct external source has been granted

requires_explicit_authorization: read ASF pixels outside the previously approved event-only staging
publish or redistribute vector or derived pixels
